description: This file defines the WebBridge class, which implements plugin interfaces for a web-based communication component within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures related to plugin management, WebSocket communication, and message handling.

classes.name: WebBridge
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, dispatcher, and WebSocket interfaces for web communication.

classes.name: WebBridge::Observer
classes.description: Represents an observer with an ID and designator, used for event subscription management.

classes.name: WebBridge::Request
classes.description: Represents a request with channel and sequence IDs, and timestamp.

classes.name: WebBridge::Cleaner
classes.description: A worker pool job class responsible for cleanup operations.

classes.name: WebBridge::Config
classes.description: Configuration class for WebBridge, including timeout and bind address.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with the service shell.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages by ID and JSON element.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of pending requests and observers.

methods.name: HasMethodSupport
methods.description: Checks if a method is supported for a given version.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Determines the destination state and handler based on a designator.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a channel to an event.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a channel from an event.
